text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the Bahraini press on Wednesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- A $1.2 million sludge treatment plant set up by the Arab Ship Repair Yard will be commissioned in June, official says.
- Gulf Cooperation Council states must follow Asia's "tigers" by basing their economies on clear visions and foundations, Bahrain's prime minister says.
- Bahrain is committed to maintaining an open economy and increasing the private sector role, the finance and national economy minister says.
- Bahrain, Pakistan discuss ways of boosting military cooperation.
- Bahrain and Malaysia will set up a joint commission to improve bilateral cooparation, Malaysian prime minister says.
